uncited: The method tackles computational costs of voxel carving by leveraging the massive parallelism of modern graphics hardware.
It constructs an explicit volume representation that can be modified interactively.

The core innovation lies in the data structure and processing pipeline: instead of storing the entire volumetric grid in 3D textures, it employs a GPU-optimal two-dimensional data representation containing only surface voxels.
This approach minimizes the memory footprint and bandwidth requirements.
